judgment.rationale: Both are Indicators in Strand 2 Reading / Sub-Strand 7 Comprehension naming the same visualisation strategy (forming mental images) to enhance understanding of level-appropriate texts, and they share the single LC 58747015 (full tag and text overlap). The second SFI is B2.2.7.2.5 at BASIC 2 (rank 1) and the first is B3.2.7.2.3 at BASIC 3 (rank 2), so the permitted developmental direction is lower-to-higher (second_to_first). Beyond repeated wording, the pair-specific change is substantive: the BASIC 2 indicator sits under content standard B2.2.7.2 ('understand and interpret texts'), while the BASIC 3 indicator sits under B3.2.7.2 ('understand, interpret and appreciate a variety of literary texts'), and 'level-appropriate texts' scales with the grade; the BASIC 3 wording also anchors the imaging explicitly to the act of reading text. Fluency with visualisation on simpler BASIC 2 texts plausibly supports success applying the same strategy to the broader, more demanding BASIC 3 literary range.
